requirements.requirement: Account for every rounded tree addition in the reduction.
requirements.evidence: Research/Projects/BinaryTreeReduction/Reduction.lean:11-13 rounds addition at every internal node. Lines 112-171 induct on a depth budget, apply round_spec at each node (150-151), and scale both child perturbations by its error factor (152-165). Lines 174-180 specialize to actual depth, counting at most depth addition errors on every path.

requirements.requirement: Establish the gamma(depth+1,u) componentwise perturbation bound.
requirements.evidence: Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Gamma.lean:8-9 defines gamma k u = k*u/(1-k*u); lines 33-54 prove its one-error recurrence. Submission.lean:77-89 composes multiplication bound u with addition bound gamma depth u using IsPerturbation.trans (Reduction.lean:41-71), then proves u + gamma depth u*(1+u) ≤ gamma (depth+1) u. Depth-zero leaves are included.
